items.severity: CRITICAL — Peer Repo Data Error Caught & Corrected During Line-by-Line Audit of `main`
items.institution: SoFi Bank, N.A. (`data/banks.json` Row 16 on `main`)
items.field_affected: Non-Direct-Deposit Savings APY (`3.30%` Falsely Claimed Instead of Official `0.80% APY`)
items.observation: Line-by-line audit of `data/banks.json` merged onto `main` (`PR #1–#3`, `session-46ab1baa`) caught a critical factual error: `sofi-savings` listed `{'min': 0, 'apy': 3.3, 'condition': 'Standard savings APY, no direct deposit'}`. In reality, per **Table 5** of SoFi Bank's official *Rate Sheet (Effective October 20, 2026)* PDF (`SoFi-Bank-Rate-Sheet-October-20-2026.pdf`), accounts **without** Eligible Direct Deposit, $5,000/31-day Qualifying Deposits, or SoFi Plus earn **`0.80% APY`** (`0.79708%` interest rate) — NOT `3.30% APY`! That single error overstates passive Year-1 interest on `$250,000` by **`$6,250.00`** (`$8,250` vs `$2,000`).
items.action_taken: Corrected `data/banks.json` and split `sofi-checking-savings-dd` (`3.30%` base / `4.40%` 6-mo boost WITH qualifying activity) vs `sofi-savings-no-dd` (`0.80%` passive APY) in `datasets/national-banks.json` with direct link to official Oct 20, 2026 PDF.

items.action_taken: Upgraded both `datasets/national-banks.json` and `data/banks.json` with exact verbatim primary-source links and dates.

items.severity: HIGH — Shared Single FDIC Charter Between CIT Bank & First Citizens Bank

items.action_taken: Flagged on all tables and excluded CIT + First Citizens pairing from multi-bank max-FDIC portfolios.

items.severity: HIGH — Structural $250,000 Balance Tier Threshold vs Single-Owner FDIC Ceiling + 9-Day Promo Expiry
items.institution: Barclays Bank Delaware — Barclays Tiered Savings
items.observation: Barclays Tiered Savings requires at least **`$250,000.00`** to unlock its top **`3.65% APY`** tier (`3.50%` under `$250k`, accurate `10/07/2026`). For an individual single-owner account without POD beneficiaries, every penny of accrued interest above `$250,000` (`$9,125` in Year 1) is **uninsured**! Additionally, Barclays' `$200` bonus (`$25k` held 120d) expires **`2026-10-31`** (9 days from `2026-10-22`).
items.action_taken: Recommended opening Barclays Tiered Savings strictly as a **Joint Account (`$500k` FDIC limit)** or **POD Trust (`$250k`/beneficiary up to `$1.25M`)** when targeting `$250,000+`.
